confirmed_decisions: Do not wait for Lovable/Mailgun as the only solution.
Keep Replit Email Test Console as an independent diagnostic tool, not production router.
Use Resend + send.lohashare.com as Primary Provider candidate.
Use Zoho SMTP + tech@lohashare.com as Secondary/Backup Provider candidate.
Keep auth_emails on legacy Lovable Emails in Phase 1.
Keep EMAIL_PROVIDER_ROUTER_ENABLED=false until explicit production cutover.
Keep EMAIL_FALLBACK_ENABLED=false/unset until Zoho fallback is approved.
Do not enable global router flag because Preview and Production share backend, queue, cron and secrets.
Unsubscribe route safety patch: GET only confirmation, POST performs suppression.
